system.name: Drs.NAS
system.one_liner: an ultra-efficient neural architecture search framework that finds deep recommendation-system architectures via superproxy-guided differentiable graph search

components.name: Layer D
components.role: last supernet layer in the stack, mirrored later as the final architecture's layer stack

components.name: Superproxies
components.role: compact seven-dimensional proxy representation computed per candidate operator

components.name: Vertex V1
components.role: graph vertex representing a candidate layer in the DAG search space

components.name: Vertex VD
components.role: last vertex in the DAG search space, corresponding to Layer D

components.name: Optimal candidate architecture
components.role: relaxed, gradient-searched architecture over the DAG vertices

components.name: Optimal searched architecture
components.role: final discrete layered architecture obtained by discretizing the candidate

content.key_idea: Drs.NAS turns a layered supernet into cheap superproxy vectors, builds a DAG search space from them, relaxes it for gradient-based multi-objective search, then discretizes the result into a concrete layered architecture.
content.reading_order: Z-pattern across four quadrants: top-left superproxy formulation feeds top-right DAG search-space generation, then bottom-right relaxed search discretizes into the bottom-left final architecture.

evidence: Fig. 1 presents the overview of Drs.NAS framework, which is mainly composed of four major phases.
we construct a graph-based search space built on top of the computed superproxies
we relax the discrete graph search space, using Gumbel-Softmax, to enable a differentiable NAS process

summary: Figure 1 lays out Drs.NAS's four-phase framework for searching deep recommendation-system (DRS) architectures, folded into a 2x2 grid. In Superproxy Formulation (top-left, §3.2), a supernet's stacked Layers, each holding several candidate operators, undergo Proxy Computation into compact Superproxies. In Search Space Generation (top-right, §3.3), these superproxies become colored operator markers inside DAG Vertices (V1...VD), forming the graph-based DAG search space. The bottom-right panel then applies Search Space Relaxation (§3.4) and Gradient-Based Search (§3.5, Gumbel-Softmax) to these vertices to obtain an Optimal candidate architecture, which a Discretize arrow converts, bottom-left, into the concrete stacked-Layer Optimal searched architecture. Purple boxes consistently denote layers and blue boxes denote DAG vertices, with small colored squares carrying operator identity across all four panels.
summary_zh: 该图展示 Drs.NAS 四阶段框架：Layer 经 Proxy Computation 得 Superproxies，建成 DAG 搜索空间，经松弛与梯度搜索得候选架构，再 Discretize 为最终架构。
notes: layout-proposal: four-quadrant phase pipeline — four sequential phases (superproxy formulation, search-space generation, relaxation/gradient search, discretization) are folded into a 2x2 grid read top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left, rather than drawn as one straight pipeline.
